prompt.main_subject: One generic approved young adult woman with long smooth ombre brown-to-golden-blonde hair, bright open-mouth smile, fair warm skin, soft natural makeup, wearing a soft blush-pink ribbed wrap crop top and deep burgundy velvet wrap skirt with delicate jewelry.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daylight from the open outdoor side, soft shadows and gentle highlights, warm inviting bright cheerful lifestyle atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame DSLR look, 50mm portrait lens, f/2.0, ISO 100, 1/250s, sharp subject with softly blurred background, realistic skin and fabric texture.
